fields.name: name
fields.help: Name the preset is registered and listed under.

fields.name: dataset
fields.help: A Hugging Face dataset with a "text" column.

fields.name: tokenizer
fields.help: "bpe" (trained on this dataset), "gpt2" or "bytes".

fields.name: vocab_size
fields.help: Target vocabulary size for "bpe"; fixed by the tokenizer otherwise.

fields.name: context_length
fields.help: Tokens the model sees at once.

fields.name: max_steps
fields.help: Training steps. Each step reads batch_size sequences.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.help: Sequences per training step.

fields.name: learning_rate
fields.help: Peak learning rate; it warms up, then decays on a cosine.

fields.name: weight_decay
fields.help: AdamW weight decay (not applied to norms and biases).

fields.name: betas
fields.help: AdamW beta1 and beta2.

fields.name: eps
fields.help: AdamW epsilon.

fields.name: warmup_steps
fields.help: Steps over which the learning rate rises from zero.

fields.name: grad_clip
fields.help: Largest gradient norm; bigger gradients are scaled down.

fields.name: precision
fields.help: "fp32", or "fp16" for mixed precision on a CUDA GPU.

fields.name: dataset_config
fields.help: The dataset's configuration name, if it has one.

fields.name: hub_data
fields.help: Hub dataset repo holding this preset's tokens (see publish_data), so they download instead of tokenizing.

fields.name: train_docs
fields.help: Documents to train on; None is the whole train split.

fields.name: holdout_docs
fields.help: When above 0, hold out the first N train documents as validation.

fields.name: tokenizer_train_docs
fields.help: Documents used to train a "bpe" tokenizer.

fields.name: eval_interval
fields.help: Evaluate on the validation documents every N steps.

fields.name: eval_docs
fields.help: Validation documents used: the first N, the same for every run.

fields.name: sample_interval
fields.help: Generate sample text every N steps.

fields.name: sample_length
fields.help: Tokens in each generated sample.

fields.name: sample_prompt
fields.help: Text the samples continue; empty starts from scratch.

fields.name: sample_temperature
fields.help: Sampling temperature; lower is more predictable.

fields.name: checkpoint_interval
fields.help: Save a checkpoint every N steps.

fields.name: keep_checkpoints
fields.help: How many recent checkpoints to keep.
